say:2:1041573501:1.text: Uh-oh, your cup! It just flew right out the window! What if it lands in the Skyrealm Forest...
say:2:1041573501:1.source_cn: 糟了，你的水杯，飞出屋外了！不会落到空境森林里了吧……

say:3:1041573502:1.text: Did it just... grow wings out of nowhere...?

say:4:1041573503:1.text: I-I was only trying to cool the tea with a breeze spell, but my magic sometimes... does its own thing. I'm sorry!
say:4:1041573503:1.source_cn: 我本来只是想用微风术把里面的热茶吹凉，但我的魔法总会突...

say:5:1041573504:1.text: No, no, no! That was amazing.

say:6:1041573505:1.text: I've tried making Stitchy fly too, but he never goes very far.
say:6:1041573505:1.source_cn: 我也试过让奇奇飞起来，像风筝那样……可惜飞不了太远。

say:7:1041573506:1.text: ...Stitchy? That sounds just like a rodent's name. I almost pictured a baby squirrel beside you.
say:7:1041573506:1.source_cn: ……奇奇？唔，我的啮齿类朋友们会叫我皮皮，难道奇奇也是...

say:8:1041573507:1.text: Ah, um... Stitchy is my doll.

say:9:1041573508:1.text: Mom gave him to me. He's... my best friend.
say:9:1041573508:1.source_cn: 它是妈妈送给我的，是我最好的朋友。

say:10:1041573509:1.text: Oh. Right. I see. *awkward chuckle* Also, uh, hope I didn't mess up your day.
say:10:1041573509:1.source_cn: 呃，虽然没有很明白，但你要是不嫌我麻烦……

say:11:1041573510:1.text: I–I mean, just the other day, I accidentally turned every doll's nose on the shopping street rainbow-colored...
say:11:1041573510:1.source_cn: 就、就比如前几天，我不小心把商业街上所有的玩偶鼻子都变...

say:12:1041573511:1.text: Vendors said I saved them the trouble of painting, though...
say:12:1041573511:1.source_cn: 虽然老板夸我为他们节省了上色的时间……

say:13:1041573512:1.text: Whoa! That sounds fun! I bet Stitchy would love having a colorful nose!
say:13:1041573512:1.source_cn: 哇！听起来真有趣，要是奇奇会说话，它一定会喜欢彩色的！

say:14:1041573513:1.source_cn: 那我们可以成为好朋友！

say:15:1041573514:1.text: Great! Friends! I'm Daimon. What is your name?
say:15:1041573514:1.source_cn: 朋友……真的吗？我叫戴蒙，你呢，你叫皮皮吗？

say:16:1041573515:1.text: I'm Pippa. Nice to meet you, Daimon!
say:16:1041573515:1.source_cn: 我叫皮帕，叫我皮皮也行，很高兴认识你，戴蒙！

say:17:1041573516:1.text: Will you come back tomorrow? I want to go boating with you. And fishing.
say:17:1041573516:1.source_cn: 明天你还会再来这里吗？我想和你一起去划船、钓鱼。

say:18:1041573517:1.text: I suppose you won't even need a rod. You give it a wave, and fish will just fly out of the lake!
say:18:1041573517:1.source_cn: 皮皮的魔法那么厉害，说不定用不着出钩，湖里的鱼就都自己...

say:19:1041573518:1.text: Oh no... I have a bad feeling about this...
say:19:1041573518:1.source_cn: 啊……鱼……船……飞起来……我想起一些不好的回忆……

say:20:1041573519:1.text: Whatever! Daimon likes it, so we're doing it!
say:20:1041573519:1.source_cn: 诶，不管了，戴蒙喜欢，我们就去钓鱼！

say:21:1041573520:1.text: Tomorrow I'll bring Professor Solise and a bunch of others, too. You will be everyone's favorite!
say:21:1041573520:1.source_cn: 明天，我叫上娑丽丝老师，还有好多好多人一起来，他们一定...
